title: Barrett realization of constructible complexes in the derived ind-heart
statement: Fix D, l, hl, Ω and finite-type k₀-schemes X₀,Y₀ as in [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], with geometric fibres and ordinary common-stage constructible derived categories from [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. For a morphism f:X₀→Y₀, there are fully faithful realizations J_T:D_c^b(T,Ω)→D⁺(Ind(C_T)), where C_T is the specified small ordinary constructible heart. J_X carries each heart object A to y(A)[0], and every cohomology object of J_Y(K) is represented by an object of C_Y. The represented derived objects J_Y(B) detect isomorphisms in D⁺(Ind(C_Y)). Write F_T and U_T for the exact free/forgetful Frobenius functors. There is a natural isomorphism f^*⋙J_X⋙D⁺F_X ≅ J_Y⋙D⁺F_Y⋙D⁺(ind-Weil f^*), using exactly the normalized inverse image of that definition. Independent derived-category localization universes are allowed. This assertion mentions no right-adjoint direct image.

source.document: Owen Barrett, The derived category of the abelian category of constructible sheaves, arXiv:2005.10859; Kashiwara–Schapira, Categories and Sheaves; SGA 4
source.place: Barrett Theorem 1.1 and its proof in §3 via Theorem 1.3; Categories and Sheaves §15.3 (bounded derived full faithfulness of the exact ind embedding); finite open-cover descent. The common-stage and free-induction assembly is written by B5.

proof.text: Apply [lem-zl-barrett-ordinary-ind-realization] to f. Retain its exact left adjoint L, fully faithful functors J_X,J_Y, heart and cohomology formulas, coverage of single representables, and ordinary inverse-image isomorphism e. These data do not involve Frobenius or direct image.

Let F_Y,F_X be the exact ind-Frobenius autoequivalences and let e_F:L⋙F_X≅F_Y⋙L be the prescribed ind square. Choose the right adjoint R of L. Because F_Y and F_X are equivalences, the right mate of e_F inverse is invertible. Lift L⊣R using [lem-sf-fixed-pair-adjunction-lift]. Now L⋙Free_X and Free_Y⋙(ind-Weil f*) have right adjoints U_X⋙R and lifted R⋙U_Y, identified by the underlying-object comparison. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives L⋙Free_X≅Free_Y⋙(ind-Weil f*). This is the private proved freeTransportIso in Lean. Exactness of the free functors is the source Free.preservesHomology_functor used in [lem-sf-fixed-pair-derived-forget-comparison].

Apply exact bounded-below derivation to the heart-level free comparison. Invert the composition isomorphism on the L⋙Free_X side and use the forward composition isomorphism on Free_Y⋙(ind-Weil f*). Whisker the ordinary comparison e by D⁺Free_X and this derived free comparison by J_Y. Their composite is exactly the asserted free-induction inverse-image isomorphism, with all four independently chosen localization universes retained.

For an arrow g satisfying the hypothesis of the isomorphism test, fix A,n and choose the supplied B and i:J_Y(B)≅y(A)[-n]. Injectivity of postcomposition from y(A)[-n] follows by precomposing with i.hom and using injectivity from J_Y(B). Given a:y(A)[-n]→N, choose b:J_Y(B)→M with b g=i.hom a; then i.inv b maps to a. Thus all single representable Hom maps are bijective. Apply [lem-zl-ind-derived-representable-detection]. Assemble this with the retained full faithfulness, heart, cohomology and free-comparison data.

proof_origin.place: R5: ordinary realization, free comparison by unique left adjoints and exact derived composition, and explicit Hom transport to the generic detection lemma. The free comparison and final assembly are complete Lean proofs.

lean.statement:
theorem zlBarrettIndRealization
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (Ind (zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl X₀))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (Ind (zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl Y₀))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{tX} (zlIndWeilHeart D l hl Ω X₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{tY} (zlIndWeilHeart D l hl Ω Y₀)] (f : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) :
    ∃ (JX : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω
        (D.geometricFiber X₀).left ⥤
        DerivedCategory.Plus (Ind (zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl X₀)))
      (JY : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω
        (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left ⥤
        DerivedCategory.Plus (Ind (zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl Y₀))),
      Nonempty JX.FullyFaithful ∧ Nonempty JY.FullyFaithful ∧
      (∀ A : zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl X₀,
        Nonempty (JX.obj (AsSmall.down.obj A).obj ≅
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (Ind.yoneda.obj A))) ∧
      (∀ (K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω
          (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left) (n : ℤ),
        ∃ A : zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl Y₀,
          Nonempty (Ind.yoneda.obj A ≅
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).obj (JY.obj K))) ∧
      Nonempty (zlPull D l hl Ω f ⋙ JX ⋙ zlIndDerivedFree D l hl Ω X₀ ≅
        JY ⋙ zlIndDerivedFree D l hl Ω Y₀ ⋙ zlIndDerivedPull D l hl Ω f) ∧
      (∀ {M N : DerivedCategory.Plus (Ind (zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl Y₀))} (g : M ⟶ N),
        (∀ B, Function.Bijective (fun h : JY.obj B ⟶ M ↦ h ≫ g)) → IsIso g)
